title: netty-incubator-codec-ohttp: OHTTP codecs retain consumed outer cumulation buffers after completed exchanges…
description: The netty-incubator-codec-ohttp library contains a vulnerability where OHTTP codecs retain consumed outer cumulation buffers after completed exchanges. This retention causes the codec to hold onto large buffers for the lifetime of idle keep-alive connections, potentially leading to memory pressure across many such connections. The issue affects versions from 0.0.20.Final up to but not including 0.0.27.Final. A fix is available in version 0.0.27.Final.
